shared_elements: panel of incised script / rows of text signs
figures set below or beside an inscribed text field
justification: Both surfaces combine a block of horizontally ruled inscription with carved human figures placed below/around it, which is a fairly specific commemorative scheme shared by the two. However, A shows a detailed multi-register scene of profile figures seated at offering tables interacting with one another, while B shows only isolated frontal standing figures in niches with no interaction, no seated figures and no furniture or objects.
